pages.title: Insurance & FAQ
pages.description: Insurance, payments, first visits and cancellations.

texts: Which insurance plans do you accept?
We accept most major plans. Contact us with your plan details and we will confirm your coverage.
What should I bring to my first visit?
A photo ID, your insurance card and a list of any medicines you take.
How do I cancel or reschedule?
Call us or reply to your confirmation at least 24 hours before your appointment.
Yes — ask our team about flexible payment options for larger treatments.
Our patient coordinator is happy to help.
